why: Preston in HVAC since 1999, Justin since 2000
Our own sheet metal fab shop
Your customers already make your case. Jeff W. wrote that “within 2 hours Karlee called me and sent Will out 30 minutes later.” Tyler N. wrote that “he didn’t try to up-sale.”
Your website can’t say any of it. The top of your homepage says “Comfort Solutions Simplified,” with no HVAC and no Wichita, so Google can’t tell what you do or where.
So we built a demo that says HVAC company in Wichita, KS at the very top, gives AC repair and furnace repair their own pages, and puts your customers’ words beside the work.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the HVAC Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page of the demo: what costs you calls today, and the fix.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: The top of your homepage says “Comfort Solutions Simplified.” Google can’t tell you’re an HVAC company in Wichita.
The “Financing” and “Get Financed” buttons open a page we couldn’t load.
Geothermal heat pumps, a real specialty, share one short paragraph with every other service.
fixes: A headline that says HVAC company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Your number one tap away, with every service listed.
Geothermal and water-source heat pumps listed as their own service.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn’t think to mention still get their own pages.

cards.title: AC Repair
cards.why: When the AC quits in a Wichita summer, people search and call the first company they find.
problems: AC repair has no page of its own, so a search for “AC repair Wichita KS” has nothing of yours to land on.
Your customers’ same-day stories and no-up-sell stories appear on Google only.
fixes: A page for AC repair in Wichita, KS, with what a visit involves.
Reviews from these jobs beside each point.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Furnace Repair
cards.why: When the heat is out, a homeowner calls the first company they can reach.
problems: Furnace repair has no page of its own, only one paragraph on a shared services page.
Your maintenance-plans page talks about replacing an air conditioner. Visitors who click it get a replacement pitch and no plan.
fixes: A page for furnace repair in Wichita, KS, covering repair and replacement.
Reviews from homeowners who got their heat back.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a customer with a dead AC decides to call you.
problems: Your site says “24/7” above Monday to Friday, 8 to 5 hours, so a Saturday no-heat visitor gets two answers.
No street address appears anywhere on the site.
fixes: Your number one tap away, with your hours and a short list of what to have ready.
One set of hours that matches how you work.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.
